design.title: Dictionary of Design
design.description: An authored, illustrated reference for 113 art and design terms — each one built from the same small vector visual grammar, not a stock-illustration glossary.

inner.title: Dictionary of Inner Experience
inner.description: An authored vocabulary for 77 inner states — emotions, moods, and existential experiences — distinguished by real psychological criteria, not treated as interchangeable synonyms.

terms.def: A pre-designed layout or framework used as a starting point for consistent production.

terms.name: Collage
terms.def: A technique of combining diverse, often unrelated visual fragments into one new, unified composition.

terms.def: A single repeatable unit whose form determines the structure and proportions of a larger composition.

terms.name: Pattern
terms.def: A repeating structural motif, distinguished from plain Repetition by having its own internal modular logic.

terms.name: Silhouette
terms.def: The flattened outline of a volumetric object, shown without internal depth, detail, or texture.

terms.name: Tectonics
terms.def: The expressive articulation of a structure's logic through the treatment of its surface and form.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><path d="M15 55 L30 25 L45 45 L60 20 L75 40 L85 55 Z" fill="none" stroke="var(--ext)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

terms.name: Texture (Tactile Texture)
terms.def: A surface's tangible structure, perceived visually or by touch, distinguished from Pattern by describing surface quality rather than a repeating motif.

terms.name: Affordance
terms.def: A property of a form's shape that suggests, on its own, how it is meant to be used.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="36" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.5"/><rect x="70" y="30" width="18" height="16" rx="8" fill="var(--ext)"/></svg>

terms.name: Animation Sequence
terms.def: A series of frames or movements that together create the illusion of motion or narrative.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><rect x="14" y="20" width="16" height="36" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.2"/><rect x="34" y="20" width="16" height="36" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.2"/><rect x="54" y="20" width="16" height="36" fill="var(--ext)" opacity="0.15" stroke="var(--ext)" stroke-width="1.5"/><rect x="74" y="20" width="12" height="36" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.2"/></svg>

terms.name: Forcing Function
terms.def: A design feature that makes a specific error physically impossible until a required step is completed.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><rect x="15" y="26" width="34" height="20" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.5"/><rect x="55" y="26" width="30" height="20" fill="var(--ext)" opacity="0.15" stroke="var(--ext)" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="49" y1="36" x2="55" y2="36" stroke="var(--ext)" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/></svg>

terms.name: Interaction Design
terms.def: The creation and structuring of interactive behavior between users and a digital or physical system.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="55" cy="38" r="16" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/><polygon points="20,20 34,50 38,36 52,32" fill="var(--ext)"/></svg>

terms.name: Interface
terms.def: A designed mediator that enables interaction and communication between a system and its user.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><rect x="15" y="15" width="70" height="46" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="50" cy="38" r="9" fill="var(--ext)"/></svg>

terms.name: Mockup
terms.def: A realistic visual representation of a design, used for presentation and evaluation before it is built.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><rect x="18" y="14" width="64" height="48" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="var(--ext)" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="26" y="22" width="48" height="8" fill="var(--ink-faint)" opacity="0.4"/><rect x="26" y="34" width="30" height="18" fill="var(--ext)" opacity="0.3"/></svg>

terms.name: Motion Graphics
terms.def: Animated visual elements used to convey information, narrative, or aesthetic expression over time.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="20" cy="45" r="6" fill="var(--ext)" opacity="0.25"/><circle cx="40" cy="35" r="6" fill="var(--ext)" opacity="0.5"/><circle cx="60" cy="25" r="6" fill="var(--ext)" opacity="0.8"/><circle cx="78" cy="18" r="6" fill="var(--ext)"/></svg>

terms.name: Prototype
terms.def: An interactive or tangible model of a design used to test its functionality, flow, and user experience.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><rect x="15" y="16" width="70" height="44" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/><rect x="22" y="23" width="40" height="8" fill="var(--ink-faint)" opacity="0.3"/><polygon points="60,42 72,58 65,56 60,64" fill="var(--ext)"/></svg>

terms.name: Responsive Design
terms.def: A design approach that keeps visual and functional consistency across devices and screen sizes of different proportions.

terms.name: Storyboard
terms.def: A sequential visual plan depicting scenes or interactions ahead of animation, video, or interface production.

terms.def: The overall experience and satisfaction of a person interacting with a product, system, or service, end to end.

terms.name: User Interface (UI)
terms.def: The design of the specific interactive elements through which a person engages with a digital system.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><rect x="18" y="18" width="64" height="40" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="32" cy="38" r="6" fill="var(--ext)"/><rect x="48" y="30" width="24" height="6" fill="var(--ink-faint)" opacity="0.4"/><rect x="48" y="42" width="16" height="6" fill="var(--ink-faint)" opacity="0.4"/></svg>

terms.name: Wireframe
terms.def: A simplified visual guide showing a layout's structure and hierarchy without detailed styling.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><rect x="15" y="16" width="70" height="10" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.5"/><rect x="15" y="32" width="30" height="24" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.5"/><rect x="49" y="32" width="36" height="24" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg>

terms.name: Illustration Pack
terms.def: A collection of related illustrations sharing one style and thematic language, used consistently across a project.

terms.def: A visual representation of data or information — using charts, icons, and diagrams — designed for quick, clear understanding.

terms.def: The three basic units of typographic spacing: the space between one specific letter pair, the space applied evenly across a run of letters, and the vertical space between lines.

terms.name: Legibility
terms.def: Whether individual letterforms can be told apart from one another at a glance.

terms.def: Custom-drawn letterforms that function as an independent visual image rather than as reusable type.

terms.name: Readability
terms.def: Whether continuous text can be comfortably read over a passage, a property of a full block of type rather than of single letterforms.

terms.def: Letterforms treated as a visual system, balancing legibility, rhythm, and expressive form.

terms.name: Typography System
terms.def: The organized use of typefaces, styles, spacing, and hierarchy to communicate clearly and consistently across a project.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><text x="12" y="55" font-family="Archivo" font-weight="700" font-size="12" fill="var(--ink-faint)">Aa</text><text x="24.6" y="55" font-family="Archivo" font-weight="700" font-size="16" fill="var(--ink-faint)">Aa</text><text x="41.400000000000006" y="55" font-family="Archivo" font-weight="700" font-size="22" fill="var(--ink-faint)">Aa</text><text x="64.5" y="55" font-family="Archivo" font-weight="700" font-size="30" fill="var(--ext)">Aa</text></svg>

terms.name: Anger
terms.def: A response to a perceived wrong, obstacle, or violation, oriented toward confrontation.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="28" cy="38" r="14" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="72" cy="38" r="14" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M44 30 L52 38 L44 46 M56 30 L48 38 L56 46" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.3"/></svg>

terms.name: Disgust
terms.def: A visceral aversive reaction to something perceived as contaminating or unacceptable, with a genuinely bodily signature distinguishing it from Contempt's coolness.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="65" cy="38" r="14" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M50 38 H35" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#rc)"/><defs><marker id="rc" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="3" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L6,3 L0,6 Z" fill="var(--int)"/></marker></defs></svg>

terms.name: Fear
terms.def: A rapid response to a perceived immediate, identifiable threat.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="30" cy="38" r="9" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M42 38 H80" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 3"/><path d="M72 32 L82 38 L72 44" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3"/></svg>

terms.name: Joy
terms.def: A response to something appraised as good, moderate to high in activation, and tied to a specific moment rather than sustained.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="8" fill="var(--int)"/><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="20" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.5"/><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="30" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.25"/></svg>

terms.name: Sadness
terms.def: A response to loss or an unmet want, broad in cause and duration.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="24" r="10" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.5"/><path d="M50 34 V58" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/><circle cx="50" cy="62" r="6" fill="var(--int)"/></svg>

terms.name: Surprise
terms.def: A brief orienting reaction to an unexpected event, valence-neutral until appraisal resolves it toward pleasant or unpleasant. Its status as a true emotion versus a pre-emotional reflex is genuinely disputed in the literature.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="26" cy="26" r="9" fill="var(--int)"/><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="6" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.7"/><circle cx="68" cy="24" r="4" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.4"/><circle cx="70" cy="52" r="3" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.25"/></svg>

terms.name: Antipathy
terms.def: A settled dislike or aversion toward someone or something, milder and more passive than Hatred.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="30" cy="38" r="9" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M42 38 H80" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 3"/><path d="M72 32 L82 38 L72 44" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3"/></svg>

terms.name: Anxiety
terms.def: A sustained state of tension and worry without one clear, immediate object — diffuse, future-oriented, and cognitively elaborated, unlike Fear's sharp present focus.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><path d="M15 38 Q30 15 45 38 Q60 61 75 38 Q83 26 90 38" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2"/></svg>

terms.name: Apprehension
terms.def: Dread's quieter sibling — a low-intensity anticipatory discomfort about a known-ish upcoming event.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><path d="M25 42 Q40 28 55 42 Q68 54 78 42" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7"/></svg>

terms.name: Contempt
terms.def: A cool, dismissive sense of superiority toward someone judged unworthy — low activation compared to Anger, defined by distance rather than heat.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="65" cy="38" r="14" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M50 38 H35" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#rc)"/><defs><marker id="rc" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="3" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L6,3 L0,6 Z" fill="var(--int)"/></marker></defs></svg>

terms.name: Delight
terms.def: Joy intensified by a violated positive expectation — something better than hoped for.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="8" fill="var(--int)"/><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="20" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.5"/><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="30" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.25"/></svg>

terms.name: Disappointment
terms.def: Sadness from an expectation that was violated — inherently comparative between what happened and what was expected.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="24" r="10" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.5"/><path d="M50 34 V58" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/><circle cx="50" cy="62" r="6" fill="var(--int)"/></svg>

terms.name: Dread
terms.def: Fear's anticipatory register — the threat is specific and identified, only its timing is still to come.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="72" cy="38" r="5" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M20 38 H62" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 3"/><path d="M52 32 L62 38 L52 44" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3"/><path d="M50 20 L50 56" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-dasharray="1 3" opacity="0.4"/></svg>

terms.name: Envy
terms.def: Wanting a quality, possession, or standing that someone else has, with no existing relationship at stake — the pain is purely comparative, unlike Jealousy.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="30" cy="42" r="10" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3"/><circle cx="66" cy="30" r="16" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M40 40 H50" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/></svg>

terms.name: Euphoria
terms.def: Joy at an intensity that can feel disorienting, often driven by exertion, relief, or a physiological cause rather than an ordinary event.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="8" fill="var(--int)"/><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="20" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.5"/><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="30" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.25"/></svg>

terms.name: Excitement
terms.def: High-activation positive anticipation, forward-looking rather than reactive.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="8" fill="var(--int)"/><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="20" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.5"/><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="30" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.25"/></svg>

terms.name: Frustration
terms.def: Tension from a blocked goal specifically — the appraisal is 'something is stopping me,' not 'someone wronged me,' and can occur with no other person involved.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="26" cy="38" r="9" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M35 38 H55" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="55" y="20" width="6" height="36" fill="var(--ink-faint)"/></svg>

terms.name: Hatred
terms.def: An intense, sustained aversion toward a person or thing, combining anger and disgust with a wish for their harm or removal.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="28" cy="38" r="14" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="72" cy="38" r="14" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M44 30 L52 38 L44 46 M56 30 L48 38 L56 46" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.3"/></svg>

terms.name: Impatience
terms.def: A low tolerance for delay — an impulse state rather than a discrete emotion, oriented toward wanting time itself to move faster.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="30" cy="38" r="10" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M42 38 H86" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#di)"/><defs><marker id="di" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" refX="3.5" refY="3.5" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L7,3.5 L0,7 Z" fill="var(--int)"/></marker></defs></svg>

terms.name: Indignation
terms.def: Anger specifically about a perceived moral violation — a fairness or rule breach — which is why it can be felt on someone else's behalf, unlike Irritation.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="30" cy="38" r="10" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M42 38 H86" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#di)"/><defs><marker id="di" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" refX="3.5" refY="3.5" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L7,3.5 L0,7 Z" fill="var(--int)"/></marker></defs></svg>

terms.name: Irritation
terms.def: Anger at low intensity, usually triggered by repeated minor friction rather than one clear wrong.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="26" cy="38" r="9" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M35 38 H55" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="55" y="20" width="6" height="36" fill="var(--ink-faint)"/></svg>

terms.name: Jealousy
terms.def: A blend of fear of loss, anger, and insecurity, requiring a third party who threatens an existing relationship or possession.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="32" cy="34" r="10" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.5"/><circle cx="48" cy="34" r="10" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.5"/><circle cx="76" cy="46" r="8" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M64 42 L70 44" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1"/></svg>

terms.name: Panic
terms.def: An acute fear response defined by intensity and physiological override, often disproportionate to or disconnected from the actual threat level.

terms.name: Rage
terms.def: Anger at an intensity that overrides self-control.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="28" cy="38" r="14" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="72" cy="38" r="14" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M44 30 L52 38 L44 46 M56 30 L48 38 L56 46" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.3"/></svg>

terms.name: Rejection
terms.def: The painful appraisal of having been excluded or refused by someone whose acceptance mattered.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="26" cy="38" r="9" fill="var(--int)"/><circle cx="74" cy="38" r="9" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/></svg>

terms.name: Relief
terms.def: A release following the resolution or removal of a sustained threat or burden — it structurally requires a preceding negative state, and is often mixed with sadness or guilt.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="18" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.15" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.3"/><circle cx="50" cy="24" r="7" fill="var(--int)"/></svg>

terms.name: Resentment
terms.def: Anger that has moved from a single episode into a lasting disposition, usually directed at a specific person with a sense of accumulated unfairness.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="35" cy="38" r="9" fill="var(--int)"/><circle cx="66" cy="38" r="6" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3"/><path d="M44 38 H58" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="1 3"/></svg>

terms.name: Thrill
terms.def: Excitement's narrower, risk- or adrenaline-specific variant.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="30" cy="38" r="10" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M42 38 H86" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#di)"/><defs><marker id="di" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" refX="3.5" refY="3.5" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L7,3.5 L0,7 Z" fill="var(--int)"/></marker></defs></svg>

terms.name: Unease
terms.def: Anxiety's least cognitively elaborated cousin — a bodily signal felt before it is understood.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><path d="M25 42 Q40 28 55 42 Q68 54 78 42" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7"/></svg>

terms.name: Absurdity
terms.def: The felt clash between a search for meaning and a world that offers no confirming answer.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><rect x="20" y="30" width="24" height="24" fill="var(--int)"/><circle cx="70" cy="30" r="14" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" transform="rotate(20 70 30)"/><path d="M62 55 L78 60" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1"/></svg>

terms.name: Awe
terms.def: A response to something perceived as vast, overwhelming one's current frame of understanding — combining high valence with a genuine cognitive frame-shift.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="56" r="5" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M12 14 Q50 -6 88 14" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M20 24 Q50 8 80 24" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/></svg>

terms.name: Curiosity
terms.def: An orientation toward an unknown that motivates approach and inquiry rather than avoidance.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="30" cy="38" r="8" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M40 34 Q55 20 68 30" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/><circle cx="72" cy="34" r="4" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3"/></svg>

terms.name: Despair
terms.def: Sadness combined with the belief that the situation cannot improve — the hopelessness itself is what separates it from ordinary sadness.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="20" r="9" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.5"/><path d="M50 29 V54" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3"/><circle cx="50" cy="60" r="8" fill="var(--int)"/><rect x="20" y="66" width="60" height="3" fill="var(--ink-faint)"/></svg>

terms.name: Existential Dread
terms.def: Dread's register when its object is one's own finitude or the structure of existence itself, rather than a specific upcoming event.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="24" r="10" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.5"/><path d="M50 34 V58" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/><circle cx="50" cy="62" r="6" fill="var(--int)"/></svg>

terms.name: Hope
terms.def: An orientation toward a desired future outcome perceived as possible, though not certain.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="30" cy="52" r="7" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M30 45 Q30 15 75 20" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/><circle cx="75" cy="20" r="4" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg>

terms.name: Longing
terms.def: A sustained wanting directed at something distant or unattainable, without Nostalgia's specific orientation to the past.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="22" cy="38" r="8" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M32 38 Q55 38 55 20" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 3"/><circle cx="72" cy="16" r="5" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/></svg>

terms.name: Meaninglessness
terms.def: A state in which one's activities or existence are experienced as lacking purpose or significance.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="36" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/></svg>

terms.name: Nostalgia
terms.def: A bittersweet longing for a fondly remembered, simultaneously unavailable past — genuinely ambivalent, not reducible to either sadness or happiness.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="38" cy="38" r="16" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.85"/><circle cx="58" cy="38" r="16" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.35"/><circle cx="74" cy="38" r="16" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.12"/></svg>

terms.name: Transcendence
terms.def: A state in which ordinary self-boundaries feel temporarily dissolved or exceeded, often experienced as connection to something larger.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><rect x="35" y="46" width="16" height="16" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.3"/><path d="M43 46 V14" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/><circle cx="43" cy="10" r="5" fill="var(--int)"/></svg>

terms.name: Void
terms.def: A chronic, existential absence of meaning — distinguished from Emptiness by having no proximate cause and no clear endpoint.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="36" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/></svg>

terms.name: Wonder
terms.def: Curiosity intensified by something that exceeds ordinary explanation, without Awe's overwhelming scale.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="35" cy="46" r="8" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M35 38 Q35 15 60 20 Q75 24 68 40" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/></svg>

terms.name: Yearning
terms.def: Longing's more intense, often bodily-felt register.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="22" cy="38" r="8" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M32 38 Q55 38 55 20" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 3"/><circle cx="72" cy="16" r="5" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/></svg>

terms.name: Affection
terms.def: A lighter, warmer, lower-stakes fondness than Love, without requiring its depth or duration.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="42" cy="38" r="12" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.6"/><circle cx="60" cy="38" r="12" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.6"/></svg>

terms.name: Alienation
terms.def: A sense of estrangement from a group, place, or one's own experience, broader and more existential than momentary Loneliness.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="6" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.6"/><circle cx="42" cy="18" r="6" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.6"/><circle cx="64" cy="24" r="6" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.6"/><circle cx="30" cy="60" r="7" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg>

terms.name: Attachment
terms.def: Security and bond rather than active positive feeling in the moment — you can be attached to someone you are currently angry at.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="42" cy="38" r="17" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.55"/><circle cx="62" cy="38" r="17" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.55"/></svg>

terms.name: Belonging
terms.def: A stable sense of being an accepted, secure part of a group or place — closer to a standing condition than a momentary connection.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="38" r="24" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3"/><circle cx="42" cy="34" r="6" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.6"/><circle cx="58" cy="42" r="6" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.6"/><circle cx="50" cy="46" r="6" fill="var(--int)"/></svg>

terms.name: Compassion
terms.def: A feeling of concern for another's suffering paired with a motivation to help.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="35" cy="42" r="10" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3"/><circle cx="60" cy="34" r="10" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M45 40 Q50 44 55 38" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.3"/></svg>

terms.name: Desire
terms.def: Wanting, which can exist with or without Love and is closer to an impulse than a discrete emotion.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="72" cy="38" r="15" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.35"/><circle cx="24" cy="38" r="7" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M33 38 H55" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 3" marker-end="url(#pt)"/><defs><marker id="pt" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="3" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L6,3 L0,6 Z" fill="var(--ink-faint)"/></marker></defs></svg>

terms.name: Devotion
terms.def: Sustained commitment and action toward someone or something, which can outlast the felt intensity of Love itself.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="30" cy="38" r="8" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M40 38 H86" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="86" cy="38" r="4" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg>

terms.name: Gratitude
terms.def: A positive feeling toward a specific person or circumstance recognized as having given something of value.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="30" cy="38" r="8" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3"/><path d="M40 38 H60" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#gt)"/><defs><marker id="gt" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="3" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L6,3 L0,6 Z" fill="var(--int)"/></marker></defs><circle cx="70" cy="38" r="10" fill="var(--int)"/></svg>

terms.name: Infatuation
terms.def: High-intensity, idealized, early-stage attraction — Love without the track record, usually short-lived.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="45" cy="38" r="18" fill="var(--int)"/><circle cx="45" cy="38" r="24" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.3"/></svg>

terms.name: Isolation
terms.def: A circumstantial state of being separated from others, which can be neutral rather than painful — the objective condition Loneliness names the felt version of.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="38" r="10" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3"/><rect x="20" y="16" width="60" height="44" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2 3" opacity="0.5"/></svg>

terms.name: Loneliness
terms.def: The painful, subjective sense of lacking wanted connection — unlike Isolation, which can be neutral, and Solitude, which can be chosen.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="72" cy="30" r="6" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/><circle cx="22" cy="52" r="4" fill="var(--int)"/><circle cx="32" cy="52" r="4" fill="var(--int)"/><circle cx="27" cy="60" r="4" fill="var(--int)"/></svg>

terms.name: Love
terms.def: A durable orientation combining care, valuing another's existence, and — variably — desire, attachment, and devotion.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="42" cy="38" r="17" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.55"/><circle cx="62" cy="38" r="17" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.55"/></svg>

terms.name: Solitude
terms.def: A chosen, often restorative state of being alone, without the pain that defines Loneliness.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="38" r="14" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/></svg>

terms.name: Trust
terms.def: A settled expectation that another person or system will not cause harm, allowing reliance without constant vigilance.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="35" cy="38" r="12" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.5"/><circle cx="65" cy="38" r="12" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.5"/><path d="M43 38 H57" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg>

terms.name: Bewilderment
terms.def: Confusion that blocks action or decision — you don't know what to do next.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="26" cy="26" r="9" fill="var(--int)"/><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="6" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.7"/><circle cx="68" cy="24" r="4" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.4"/><circle cx="70" cy="52" r="3" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.25"/></svg>

terms.name: Boredom
terms.def: A genuinely distinct low-activation unpleasant state arising from a lack of engaging stimulation, not from any specific loss.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><rect x="20" y="34" width="60" height="8" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.6"/></svg>

terms.name: Contentment
terms.def: A low-activation, present-oriented satisfaction — closer to the absence of wanting than to Joy's active positive charge.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="38" r="16" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.5"/></svg>

terms.name: Distress
terms.def: A state of general suffering under pressure — its own thing, not merely a restatement of Disappointment or Grief.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><path d="M15 38 Q30 15 45 38 Q60 61 75 38 Q83 26 90 38" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2"/></svg>

terms.name: Emptiness
terms.def: A reactive, often post-intensity depletion — tired and hollow after something, with a proximate cause, unlike Void's chronic and causeless register.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="26" cy="38" r="9" fill="var(--int)"/><circle cx="74" cy="38" r="9" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/></svg>

terms.name: Grief
terms.def: Sustained emotional suffering with a specific loss — usually bereavement — as its cause, moving in waves rather than sitting at one constant level. Often mixed with relief, anger, or guilt in the same episode.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><rect x="15" y="46" width="18" height="14" fill="var(--int)"/><rect x="37" y="46" width="18" height="14" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/><rect x="59" y="46" width="18" height="14" fill="var(--int)"/></svg>

terms.name: Happiness
terms.def: A sustained evaluation of one's life or circumstances as good — closer to a mood or trait-like state than to Joy's moment-to-moment spike.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="38" r="16" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.5"/></svg>

terms.name: Low Mood
terms.def: A sustained, diffuse state of low energy and flat affect with an open causal story, distinct from the regulation strategy of Suppression.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><rect x="20" y="34" width="60" height="8" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.6"/></svg>

terms.name: Melancholy
terms.def: Sadness without a clear proximate cause — reflective and low-activation, closer to a mood than an event-response.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="14" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.35"/><path d="M20 60 Q50 50 80 60" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/></svg>

terms.name: Perplexity
terms.def: Confusion combined with surprise — more intellectual puzzle than paralysis, unlike Bewilderment.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="26" cy="26" r="9" fill="var(--int)"/><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="6" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.7"/><circle cx="68" cy="24" r="4" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.4"/><circle cx="70" cy="52" r="3" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.25"/></svg>

terms.name: Sorrow
terms.def: A quieter, more sustained register of Sadness, without Grief's specific bereavement-related cause.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="24" r="10" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.5"/><path d="M50 34 V58" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/><circle cx="50" cy="62" r="6" fill="var(--int)"/></svg>

terms.name: Awkwardness
terms.def: A milder social friction than Embarrassment — discomfort from an interaction whose norms are unclear, rather than from a specific misstep.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="34" r="12" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7"/><circle cx="50" cy="34" r="5" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.6"/></svg>

terms.name: Embarrassment
terms.def: A light, socially-triggered discomfort from an imagined or actual observed misstep — inherently requires an audience, briefer and lower-stakes than Shame.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="34" r="12" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7"/><circle cx="50" cy="34" r="5" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.6"/></svg>

terms.name: Guilt
terms.def: A response to a specific action judged wrong, oriented toward repair rather than hiding.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="70" cy="52" r="6" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M70 46 C70 20 30 20 30 40" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#gr)"/><defs><marker id="gr" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="3" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L6,3 L0,6 Z" fill="var(--ink-faint)"/></marker></defs></svg>

terms.name: Humiliation
terms.def: Shame imposed from outside by another's action — involuntary, public, and other-caused, often carrying anger at the humiliator alongside the shame.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="34" r="16" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="50" cy="34" r="6" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M25 12 L36 22 M75 12 L64 22" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3"/></svg>

terms.name: Pride
terms.def: A sense of the self's expansion or elevation following a valued achievement or quality, recognized as one's own.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="46" r="12" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M50 34 V16" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M44 22 L50 14 L56 22" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg>

terms.name: Shame
terms.def: A painful sense that the self as a whole is deficient, prompting a wish to hide — global and self-directed, unlike Guilt's action-specific focus.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="50" cy="34" r="18" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M50 52 V64" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3"/><circle cx="50" cy="34" r="7" fill="var(--int)"/></svg>

terms.name: Avoidance
terms.def: Steering away from a feared or uncomfortable situation, thought, or feeling — a behavioral strategy, not the fear itself.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="30" cy="38" r="9" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M42 38 H80" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 3"/><path d="M72 32 L82 38 L72 44" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3"/></svg>

terms.name: Emotional Detachment
terms.def: A sustained defensive stance of disengaging from felt emotion — an interpersonal style or coping strategy, not a discrete feeling in its own right.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="30" cy="38" r="9" fill="var(--int)"/><path d="M42 38 H80" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 3"/><path d="M72 32 L82 38 L72 44" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3"/></svg>

terms.name: Rumination
terms.def: Repetitive, unresolved dwelling on a distressing thought or event, which sustains rather than processes the feeling behind it.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><path d="M15 38 Q30 15 45 38 Q60 61 75 38 Q83 26 90 38" fill="none" stroke="var(--int)" stroke-width="2"/></svg>

terms.name: Suppression
terms.def: Deliberately inhibiting the outward expression of a felt emotion — a strategy applied to a feeling, not a feeling itself.
terms.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 76"><circle cx="30" cy="38" r="12" fill="var(--int)" opacity="0.8"/><rect x="52" y="20" width="6" height="36" fill="var(--ink-faint)"/><path d="M30 38 H50" stroke="var(--ink-faint)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 3"/></svg>
